mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the completed nerve routes was most worthwhile: the head and eye inset showed what the sensors actually help the body do.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the two sensor types felt less informative than building them; it mainly showed where they sit together.

surprise.text: The weighted sensors respond not just to tilt but also to changes in straight-line movement.

arbitrary.text: Joining the sensors before adding nerves was a compatible option, but the result did not make a clear functional reason for joining them first.

continue.text: I'd probably continue: the pictures made the sensor mechanisms understandable, and I liked seeing them lead to a familiar action. The joining steps themselves were less engaging.
